title: REQ · Blank or whitespace-only text cannot be submitted and shows an inline message
summary: Block empty/whitespace prompts with an inline message
description: Context: handleSubmit returns silently when text.trim() is empty. Desired behavior: the Send button is disabled for blank text and an inline message explains that an idea is required when submit is attempted. Expected result: no submitContribution call for blank input. Why: the player gets feedback instead of silence.
acceptance_criteria: Given the textarea is empty or only whitespace, when the sheet renders, then the Send button is disabled
Given whitespace-only text, when the form is submitted, then submitContribution is not called and an inline message 'Write your idea before sending' is shown

preserve: Trimmed prompt sent on valid submit

definition_of_done: Blank input blocked with a visible message
